name: Taro-duend
description: Taro-duend is a Kav settlement and salvage and mining strike town on Kavaron That Is, run by a coach and a political postilion.

description_citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

summary.text: Taro-duend is a Kav settlement and salvage and mining strike town on Kavaron That Is, run by a coach and a political postilion.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

bio.text: Sami sent a mayday to Taro-duend and landed the Seriema in a slag pool there, where Kav rescue crews rushed the ship.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

bio.text: Sami questioned the political postilion about Sigma's Reach, and he refused to hand Sami over when a Sunstar Free Company ship demanded the escaped spies.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

bio.text: Vondam ordered the Sundog to demand the spy, and Haliya refused to help destroy a settlement of innocents.

"Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

bio.text: The Free Company swept the town, and the Kav resisted by sabotage and obstruction until the search collapsed.

status.text: Taro-duend was destroyed, with all 6,000 inhabitants killed in a nuclear blast.

citations.text: "Kavaron", section "Geography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The subedar offers to escort them to Taro-duend if they prove they are Monoists.
timeline.quote: Prove you're with the Monoists, and we will escort you to the strike town at Taro-duend.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The subedar laughs and agrees to fetch a stasis cask and take them all to Taro-duend.
timeline.quote: We'll get you a stasis cask for your singularity and take you all to Taro-duend.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami broadcasts a mayday to Taro-duend reporting twenty-four Kav soldiers with lethal radiation trauma.
timeline.quote: Twenty-four KMN aboard with lethal radiation trauma.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami denies to Taro-duend that the Seriema fired a fusion drive.
timeline.quote: It wasn't us.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami lands in a slag pool at Taro-duend and the pool is drained as Kav rescue crews rush the ship.
timeline.quote: The moment that Sami cuts thrust, someone opens the sluicegate and drains the slag pool.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Ambulances take the comatose Kav away.
timeline.quote: The Trample ambulances take them away.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami tells the coach a story of rescuing the soldiers while the coach repeats Sami's words, and offers engine telemetry as proof of innocence.
timeline.quote: I'm going to tell the truth.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Tannuk passes as a stroke-addled man to the political postilion, claiming a mining accident at Sigma's Reach.
timeline.quote: Mining accident. No air. Had to breathe liquid.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The postilion unwittingly reveals that Kav believe Sigma's Reach has miners and exports moxite.
timeline.quote: They'd want Kav labor, wouldn't they?

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Tannuk volunteers to fetch fuel while Sami investigates Sigma's Reach.
timeline.quote: So, Tan goes out to buy fuel and reaction mass for the Seriema .

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami goes to ask the political postilion what he knows about Sigma's Reach.
timeline.quote: And Sami, mouse-small in the crowds of Kav, goes to find the political postilion and ask him what he knows about Sigma's Reach.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The postilion asks Sami where their addled man Gorodoro is.
timeline.quote: Where is your addled man? Gorodoro?

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The postilion sees through Sami's act and asks if they are a liar.
timeline.quote: Are you a liar, Captain Sami?

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The postilion says he saw the hotcell cask stamped for Sigma's Reach.
timeline.quote: I saw the hotcell cask. It had a destination stamp, Sigma's Reach.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The postilion reveals that cheap moxite from Sigma's Reach ruined his moxite futures.
timeline.quote: And instead it plummeted! Undercut by cheap, clean moxite from Sigma's Reach!

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami tells the postilion that Sigma's Reach never opened, shocking him.
timeline.quote: Sigma's Reach never opened.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami asks about Mirri, showing a picture.
timeline.quote: Sami produces a picture of Mirri.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: A Sunstar Free Company ship arrives at Taro-duend demanding the escaped spies.
timeline.quote: It's the Sunstar Free Company. They're demanding we turn over the escaped spies we're harboring.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The postilion refuses to hand over Sami and decides to obstruct justice.
timeline.quote: This is a harbor for scum!

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam orders the Sundog to repeat its demand that Taro-duend hand over the spy and to launch Hopelights for surveillance.
timeline.quote: Give them another chance to hand over the spy. Launch the Hopelights.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam asks Haliya whether she could order the destruction of all Taro-duend if needed.
timeline.quote: Can you destroy it all?

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya refuses to help kill a settlement of innocents.
timeline.quote: I won't do it. I'm not going to kill a settlement full of defenseless innocents.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael sees Sunstar Free Company knights and photophoroi landing at Taro-duend to search for him.
timeline.quote: And from that ship rains an armored rain: the tiny figures of Solar Knights descending on spikes of plasma.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Free Company sweeps Taro-duend with drones and infantry.
timeline.quote: The Free Company is everywhere.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Kav of Taro-duend resist the Free Company by sabotage and obstruction.
timeline.quote: In an act of aggressive, unilateral solidarity, the Kav are raising thirteen kinds of hell.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tannuk hides Sami under his poncho as they move through the chaos.
timeline.quote: You could not ask for a better first mate or a worse fugitive than Tannuk.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami concludes the stone is making them lucky enough to avoid detection.
timeline.quote: It's the rock, Tannuk. The rock is lucky.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: A Free Company officer fires a microwave weapon on the crowd.
timeline.quote: One of the Free Company officers fires up a microwave weapon.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami speculates that a similar past rewrite emptied Sigma's Reach of its people.
timeline.quote: Maybe there were people there, before we showed up.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami refuses to give up the stone because the Metalman is their hope of finding Mirri.
timeline.quote: then he wouldn't fix our ship. And then who'd look for Mirri?

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya makes her first combat descent to Taro-duend alone.
timeline.quote: A team of photophoroi from the Moratorio Cosmogrand help her make her first combat descent.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya builds a triple-jointed pendulum to shield herself from the object by tying her actions to scripture.
timeline.quote: 3. Pendulum, encoding faith. Fashion from gleanings a triple-jointed pendulum. Dangle it from thy armor.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: In the third cave she checks, Haliya finds the Seriema.
timeline.quote: In the third cave she checks, she finds a ship called the Seriema

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya plants charges on the Seriema before going in.
timeline.quote: Plant a charge under the Seriema 's folded airfoil.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Free Company search at Taro-duend collapses under Kav resistance.
timeline.quote: The Free Company search is falling apart.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: A Hopelight pilot destroys half the airport while firing at a laser source.
timeline.quote: I blew up half the airport .

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Seriema's cargo ramp has been lowered by someone who found the ship, and Sami runs for it.
timeline.quote: Someone has found the Seriema , and the prow cargo ramp is down, opening the long jut of the number-one cargo bay to boarding.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami finds Alpharael huddled at the feet of the frozen Sunstar armor, holding the stone and the injector.
timeline.quote: a suit of golden armor standing, frozen, over Alpharael, who is huddled wretchedly around its ankles

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael says the armored woman killed Sami, though she didn't.
timeline.quote: "She killed you," Alpharael says.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam announces to all units that they are going to protocol seven and have two minutes.
timeline.quote: We are going to protocol seven. You have two minutes.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami resolves to try escaping despite near-zero odds.
timeline.quote: Our chances of flying out of here with a palestar and Hopelights overhead are zero.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tannuk reveals he has pulled the subedar armor's Guns codes.
timeline.quote: And the encryption's no match for Pinnacle breakers. I pulled them already.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami lifts the Seriema out of the cave and over the slag field.
timeline.quote: Sami gooses the ship up on a pulse of thrust.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: A Hopelight lasers off the Seriema's main drive nozzle.
timeline.quote: The main drive! They took out the mag nozzle!

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Sundog lasers every heat source in Taro-duend as it recovers its soldiers.
timeline.quote: The Sundog is killing everything in Taro-duend with its lasers.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Sundog sets houses on fire after the fleeing Kav gather inside.
timeline.quote: The Sundog lets them gather, then sets the houses on fire.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Sundog ignites its main fusion engine over Taro-duend, killing survivors with radiation and fire.
timeline.quote: The palestar has ignited its main fusion engine.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Summists massacre the civilians of Taro-duend to purge the Endstone's influence.
timeline.quote: the Summists massacred the innocent civilians in Taro-duend

citation.text: "Sami", section "Hunt for the Endstone". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Palestar Sundog under Syr Vondam destroys Taro-duend, killing all 6,000 inhabitants and igniting its fusion engine in a nuclear blast.
timeline.quote: After killing all 6,000 inhabitants, the ship ignited its fusion engine, wiping out the remains in a nuclear blast.

citation.text: "Kavaron", section "Geography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Summists massacre the civilians of Taro-duend, leading Haliya to doubt her cause.
timeline.quote: The Summists massacred the civilians of Taro-duend

citation.text: "Mission for the Endstone", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Haliya tried to take the Endstone from Alpharael; Sami and Tannuk fled Kavaron, and the Summists massacred Taro-duend.
timeline.quote: the Summists massacred the innocent civilians in Taro-duend to purge the influence of the Endstone

citation.text: "Tannuk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
